citation: U.S. House of Representatives, History, Art & Archives, James Hutchinson Woodworth (1804–1869).
locator: Moved to Chicago in 1833 and engaged in the dry-goods business
note: Modern institutional biography, graded as later scholarship rather than period evidence. It independently places James H. Woodworth in Chicago from 1833 and in the dry-goods business. This strongly corroborates the exact postal-list identity but does not establish a specific July 1835 address.
